text: Variable labels bridge raw data human-readable output. column named lvefvs_b means nothing table plot caption, “Baseline LV Ejection Fraction (%)” tells reader exactly looking . clinical research, results go directly manuscripts, grant submissions, regulatory filings, unlabeled output unprofessional error-prone. title: Data Label Handling Best Practices
text: typical clinical analysis four phases labels matter: Ingestion — labels arrive data (SAS import) need created (CSV import) Transformation — derived variables (ratios, bins, indices) need new labels Override — study-specific abbreviations corrections Consumption — labels appear plots, tables, data dictionaries label_map() extracts variable labels lookup table: result two-column data frame: key (variable name) label (descriptive text). Every column data gets entry. Unlabeled columns fall back variable name . data arrives plain CSV (labels), label_map() warns : warning intentional: prevents common mistake generating plots tables cryptic variable names like hgb egfr noticing collaborator asks mean. ingestion, ’ll create new variables — age groups, risk scores, ratios, indicator flags. variables labels didn’t exist original data. best practice label data frame using add_labels(). Labels travel data dplyr operations, never sync: label data directly, subsequent call label_map() automatically picks new labels: Sometimes label map created passed reporting module generates tables figures. case, update map directly: Different studies use different abbreviations naming conventions. AVSD study might want “Common AVV” shortened “CAVV”; mitral valve study might need different terminology entirely. Hard-coding replacements shared functions fragile. apply_label_overrides() reads YAML file applies overrides label map. file doesn’t exist, nothing happens — making safe call unconditionally. real project, labels_overrides.yml lives alongside config.yml project root committed version control. study gets file; shared analysis code never contains hard-coded label replacements. get_label() function replaces error-prone match() pattern. errors typos instead silently returning NA: Use data_dictionary() generate complete, type-annotated data dictionary one call: Use get_labels() (vectorized) look multiple labels :
